prompt: Write a single, self-contained prompt for a text-to-image model that has never heard of Chinese memes, so that it draws a giraffe version of the "大笑奶龙" (Laughing Nailong / 奶蛙) meme. Output only the prompt.
answer:
Create a full-body 3D cartoon of a baby giraffe laughing with an absurdly joyful, meme-like expression. Give it an oversized round yellow head, a broad flattened muzzle with two tiny nostrils, and eyes squeezed into little crescents. Its mouth stretches almost the entire width of its face in an enormous open grin, showing a prominent row of large, rounded white teeth, a dark mouth interior, and a little pink tongue. Its head tilts back slightly as if it is laughing uncontrollably.

Make the giraffe unmistakable with a thick, gently elongated neck, two short brown-tipped ossicones, small rounded ears, and irregular warm-brown patches on golden-yellow skin. Give it a plump belly, very short arms and legs, and a soft, glossy, toy-like surface. Its little arms spread outward as it laughs. Center the character against a plain white background with soft studio lighting. No text or other characters.
